name: Open Structure Priors v1
provenance: SALAMI public structural-annotation conventions plus Music Coach heuristics. No source audio, lyrics, melodies, or copyrighted song text are stored.
purpose: Provide lightweight browser-side priors for how many large sections to expect and prevent novelty detection from creating implausibly tiny segments.
rules: Prefer persistent multi-feature changes over a single loudness jump.
Keep large-section boundaries separated by a minimum duration unless a very strong novelty spike exists.
Treat repeated high-energy regions as hook candidates, not automatic proof of a hook.
Allow instrumental or breathing sections when a strong boundary is followed by reduced vocal-density opportunity.
Use structure priors as a starting point; the actual music can override them.
